about_p1: We had an emergency when we slid off an icy, slippery road in the middle of Black Mountain, about 175 feet down a hill. A regular tow wouldn’t work; only a winch could get us out. It was Sunday, freezing cold, snowy, and rough conditions all around. Donnie from T&D came to the rescue in about 30 minutes, fast, professional, and reasonably priced, especially for a weekend emergency.
about_p2: T&D saved the day! My 68 year old mother was going to an AirBNB and called me with broken cell service and said she was broken down on the side of a road. I barely got the street name before we got dropped. Sierra from T&D helped me figure out exactly where they were and even though we did not have the code for the gated neighborhood, sent a truck trusting that we would get into the neighborhood somehow.

reviews.author: Carolina Collision Center
reviews.text: We had an emergency when we slid off an icy, slippery road in the middle of Black Mountain, about 175 feet down a hill. A regular tow wouldn’t work; only a winch could get us out. It was Sunday, freezing cold, snowy, and rough conditions all around. Donnie from T&D came to the rescue in about 30 minutes, fast, professional, and reasonably priced, especially for a weekend emergency. Truly grateful and thankful to God for businesses like his. Highly recommend T&D if you ever need help when it really matters.

reviews.author: Kristina Campbell
reviews.text: T&D saved the day! My 68 year old mother was going to an AirBNB and called me with broken cell service and said she was broken down on the side of a road. I barely got the street name before we got dropped. Sierra from T&D helped me figure out exactly where they were and even though we did not have the code for the gated neighborhood, sent a truck trusting that we would get into the neighborhood somehow. We were able to get the code and rescue my mom on a hot day, in a steep mountainous area that she did not know. SERIOUS life savers!!!!! Sierra did it all with an amazing attitude and helpers heart! I felt helpless all the way in California!!!! They really saved the day with an end of the day call and a mission to make it happen!!! THANK YOU SO MUCH!!!!!!

reviews.author: Charlie Swor
reviews.text: I broke down late last night. My insurance's roadside assistance couldn't find anybody, so I called T&D. Tory came and was super helpful and super friendly. He towed my truck to the shop and then dropped me off at a hotel. Thanks a TON!

reviews.author: Jason Holt
reviews.text: Thes guys are great and will continue using there tow business for any future situations. There drivers kick ass and everything about them rocks. Thank you guys so much once again, very professional and liable and great communication. And there secretary was awesome as well! And budget friendly, thes are the guys to call. -foxbody

reviews.author: George Huffman
reviews.text: We had the unfortunate circumstance of having the water pump go out on my truck while headed to Tennessee. Thanks god it happened before Black Mountain and that we were able to get off the interstate. We called T and D and within an hour they were there and had my truck headed back home for what I consider a fair price. To the person I spoke with on the phone to the driver they were both nice to speak with. All of this happened on a Sunday and am very happy they were available to help. Would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Donna Bailey
reviews.text: We can’t say enough about T & D Towing today. My husband and I were traveling from Florida in North Carolina when we experienced car trouble. We got off I40 and the truck became disabled on an off ramp. Very dangerous situation. T and D came within 10 mins. Because of the nature of the trouble it became difficult to get it on to the big tow truck. Immediately another driver with T & D came to help (John and Tory) and together they got our truck on the tow truck and to the local Chevrolet dealer. A stressful situation where John and Tory helped ease the painful situation. Professional company that went over and above!!

reviews.author: Brenda Davis
reviews.text: I was stuck on the side of Old Fort Mountain at 7:30 am and it was 20 degrees out. I called T&D and they were there in just a bit over 15 minutes from the time I hung up. I was amazed. They are professionals. They are courteous, and their rates are very reasonable. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Tom Sharar
reviews.text: My car broke down in Marion, NC this AM. Words of great wisdom: "nothing is more expensive than a cheap Mercedes". My '95 SL500 has ignition problems that prompted a tow up the mountain to Ridgecrest, about 20 miles away. They said it would be 40 minutes, they were there in 25. Driver was great - professional and friendly. Got my car up the mountain at what was a surprisingly reasonable price. Could not have asked for a better experience (other than not breaking down, of course). Very pleased with every bit of the experience with T&D. Very highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jean WK
reviews.text: Our class B travel Van had engine issues and needed towed to the nearest auto shop. T & D were there in no time and even had to go back for a different type of towing setup due to the height of our van. They were so kind and efficient. They towed us to the best auto mechanic they knew which had a hotel close by. A total class act and the towing fee was very reasonable. We highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Freida Edmondson
reviews.text: Responded quickly and was professional and kind. Solved our problem fast with knowledge. Reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Robert Gibbs
reviews.text: Saved the day when we lost a wheel on the way back home to florida. Very professional and courteous. Price was exceptional.

reviews.author: Stork Maintenance
reviews.text: These "people" demanded $1200 for a 150 yard tow of a truck that had the fuel backed up on an uphill. The price is so high because they were arranged by the local fire department and they also threatened/rushed the payment in 10 minutes, if not they would tow the truck to their yard and would add up additional fees.

reviews.author: Prentiss Brewer
reviews.text: Kyle saved us! We were broken down on the side of I-40 and were going to have to wait 2 hours for AAA!!! Not only was he there quickly (15-20 minutes) but he had us sit in the truck in the AC while he loaded the car and entertained us on the ride to the repair shop. Kyle really lifted our moods and was a godsend!

reviews.author: Matt Norris
reviews.text: Highly recommend T&D. They are prompt, professional, and care about their customers. My family and I were driving down the mountain back to Florida from Beech Mountain. The truck shutoff and would not start back up. No phone service. Freezing cold. I had to walk down the mountain to English dairy farm and they got me in touch with T&D. Tory arrived within 20 minutes and got us all safely down the mountain to the mechanic within 10 minutes of arriving. Thank you for your help!

reviews.author: Jasmine
reviews.text: 10/10 recommend. The driver came at his estimated time (an hour), traveled from one city to the next at a reasonable rate that shocked me. My car was delivered perfectly. They were easy to work with, friendly, and professional. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Laura Wilhelm
reviews.text: This family owned wrecker service was phenomenal. Quick to get to our location. Very professional, knowledgeable and friendly. Good, fair price to take us to the area car dealership and maintenance shop. Thank you Austin!

reviews.author: Magdalyn Reb
reviews.text: We got a flat tire while hauling hurricane Helene relief supplies to Marion, Tory came out and got us loaded up and to a tire shop quickly. He went above and beyond to take care of us and we truly appreciate him!!

reviews.author: R. Satko
reviews.text: Thanks so much to Mark at T&D who helped coordinate transportation for our family to safety off the highway after a late night flat tire and then flat spare along I-40. His kindness, professionalism, and willingness to adapt to our needs in the moment are much appreciated. One moral of the story is for everyone to check air pressure and the condition of your spare tire before it's needed.

reviews.author: Kelsey Wray
reviews.text: Completely pleased with this company. Picked us up at 1am and towed us an hour away to my parents home, couldn’t have asked for a better group of people to deal with. Highly recommend! Best pricing too, if I could give more than 5 stars I would.

reviews.author: F Trull
reviews.text: The man who showed up to tow my car wasn't the friendliest. He seemed right rude, actually. It's possible that's just his disposition, though. He came quickly, and he loaded and towed the vehicle safely to where I needed it. ( Home) . This was around 6:30 pm one evening. Recently. He did communicate truthfully and said a few things that sounded respectfully reasonable in our dealings. I guess he just rubbed me the wrong way. Also said he couldn't accept change for the extra part of the tow bill that wasn't originally quoted to me. Over the phone he said $70. Then once he was there I suppose tax had to be added. I went to make change out of quarters and a half dollar to make up the difference. He kinda laughed at me and kept telling me he couldn't accept it and later added that his boss wouldn't allow it. ? Fair enough. I ended up charging it to my credit card. All is well that ends well.

reviews.author: greg collins
reviews.text: Thank you to Mark at T&D Wrecker...we were stranded on I-40, in the rain, and pulling a trailer. He was super nice on the phone, arrived quickly, took our vehicle AND our trailer! He dropped our vehicle at a local garage then took us to a hotel. Can not thank him enough for his kindness, super professional service, and for going beyond the call of duty to make sure we were safe. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Mohammad Amro
reviews.text: Cheap thieves stole my stuff and my tools from inside the truck. At first he tried to convince me that someone broke into the truck, but when I confronted him with his lie, he told me that they had to clean it out ???! The insurance company sent an email not to take any items from inside the truck. I was able to take some of my stuff that was in his storage and there are still missing items. Cheap thieves. They even stole my clothes!!! Will see you soon in court Cheap thieves!!

reviews.author: Chris Revis
reviews.text: Called them out on a Saturday night near midnight for a broken down vehicle. Fast arrival, excellent service. Very competitive rate. I added them to my contact number on my cell, they will definitely be getting return business and will recommend to friends and family. Thank you T&D!

reviews.author: Chuck Roder
reviews.text: We had mechanical issues with our truck while passing thru the area on vacation. T&D was quick to respond and tow for a reasonable price. Great service and helped us get back in the road.

reviews.author: Emily Reeder
reviews.text: Vacation was off to a terrible start and needed tow service for truck and camper. This family quickly came to our aid and went above and beyond. Definitely exceeded our expectations. They turned our day around and we’re very grateful for them. We’ll be back to visit in the near future.

reviews.author: Peter Gross
reviews.text: The serpentine belt on my Mercedes broke as I was heading down the mountain east of Asheville. Austin from T&D arrived within 5 minutes and towed it to an auto parts store where he helped me install a replacement belt. I was back on the road just an hour after the belt broke. Extremely efficient and friendly service!

reviews.author: Salis Fele
reviews.text: Car broke down on the way up to Cherokee, made one call to T&D and they made sure my vehicle was picked up and stored safely at their facility. Even after hours, the owner himself came and helped me properly load and trailer my vehicle safely when I came to pick it up. They went above and beyond when they didn't have to. I'd give them 10 stars if I could!

reviews.author: Bishop Miles
reviews.text: The tow truck driver is very kind and helpful which made my experience much better, but that was a guy that came by named Doug. I forget his last name but this guy was an angel. He help me get my tire off and get the spare. I think God is my superhero, Mr. Doug you so much

reviews.author: Kim Ormiston
reviews.text: Responded to our call within 30 minutes and got us hooked up and to our destination very quickly. No wasted time. We highly recommend them!

reviews.author: byrd brown
reviews.text: Tory is the best. So polite and helpful. He arrived well within the window he specified. He has a great sense of humor and a winning smile. He is our very favorite tow truck driver of all time. Thanks, Tory!

reviews.author: Dawn Deck
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic!! Was there with in 10 minutes of me calling! I was about 30 miles from home and he had it there in no time! Super friendly service! Highly recommend!! Thank y’all so much!

reviews.author: shanon valentine
reviews.text: My mom’s car broke down and we call the first place that showed up on google! Thank goodness we did I would recommend their services to anyone. He responded within 20 minutes of the call was friendly and understanding. Need more good businesses and people like this.

reviews.author: Howard Moore III
reviews.text: When my daughter was run off the road on a Sunday and we could not get help from our roadside support, one call to T&D and they were there to help. We ended up needing to take the car to a shop for repairs and T&D helped with that too. I'd recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: MIRIAM M
reviews.text: My class A RV was stuck in the mud. T & D came promptly. They came and got me out easily even though I was deep in the mud. Very professional and the price was right.

reviews.author: Sarahsmileseriously Every Day
reviews.text: Punctual, professional and hard working. T&D came in to save the day when one of our trucks broke down and we had to crossdock at a pilot. I will definitely be calling them if we ever need any sort of transport vehicle services, while in the Charlotte area!

reviews.author: Dylan Goodman
reviews.text: Hands down one of the best and professional towing companies i have ever delt with in my life. The driver was very professional and had me picked up off the side of i 40 in no time. I highly recommend this company to anyone traveling through marion nc.

reviews.author: Ethan Hall
reviews.text: My alternator gave out and my vehicle stalled. Within 10 minutes of calling Tory from T&D had my car on the back of the tow truck! They helped me get to a mechanic and had excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Jacob Vest
reviews.text: Called T&D at 0700 in the morning for some Semi work. Very polite and professional. Arrived to the scene quickly and performed their job with quality. Reasonable rate as well.

reviews.author: Brendan Hogan
reviews.text: In a seemingly impossible situation TD showed up and towed out our completely jackknifed truck and boat off the side of a massive hill. Blown away by the entire process. No additional damages or problems were caused and everyone walked away safe and happy. 10/10 would use again if we have too. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Timothy “Tim” VanDusen
reviews.text: We only chose 5 stars because you couldn’t choose higher! We were coming back to Raleigh from Greeneville TN and our Jeep decided to start knocking then the motor seized. Within 20 minutes they arrived and got all 5 of us plus 2 dogs to Walmart and are coming back out to tow Jeep to dealership to get fixed!!! Excellent rates and unexpected usually companies really take advantage of you in a time of need! Great job Tory!!! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: justin sotmayor
reviews.text: What an amazing experience we had with T&D. My camper fell off a narrow bridge, and they were there in 30 min and working on getting it back on the driveway, and back to our vacation. I highly recommend them, careful, courteous, professional service!

reviews.author: Joric Akunovich
reviews.text: 10/27/22 was broken down beside hwy 40. Rear axle broken and spined. Made so many phone calls everybody says hard to fix takes several days. T&D Wrecker Service's show up in 30 minutes after looked trailer first .One heavy duty towing truck, two medium duty with bogies, and fork lift. Amazing! Funtastic! They are super professionals! Job done almost in one hour! Paid less then other services offered ! Guys, I am really appreciated !!! Jomart Akunov truck driver

reviews.author: R Schopbach
reviews.text: Great company!! Were quick to arrive and very professional and friendly! Very reasonable. Hopefully I don’t get my car stuck again but if I do will definitely be using this company!! Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: kayla bates
reviews.text: I wouldn’t give these people another dollar after they charged me $350 for literally nothing. They came out to my house to tow a vehicle which didn’t get towed anywhere the cars never even left my driveway and they literally charged me $350.... I understand paying for them taking the time to come out here but $350??! McCormicks has ALWAYS charged me $50 to take a vehicle anywhere I needed him too and then on top of that this girl who I guess works there Sierra Roland starts calling ppl and telling them crazy lies about what’s going on at my house when she didn’t have a clue anything going on! Very unprofessional!!

reviews.author: Marissa B
reviews.text: I don't know why this rating didn't post, it was about a year ago- Came to get my car within 10 minutes, we have a tight driveway that other tow personnel came and said they couldn't make it, but this fella- he made it look easy. Awesome skills! Thank you!

reviews.author: Aimee Miller
reviews.text: My son's car broke down on I-40. I called T&D and was able to speak with a person right away. They got to my son very quickly and took care of him. Thank you!

reviews.author: Anthony DiChiaro
reviews.text: I called for a tow and the gentleman was here in 20 min. He got in the car to put it in neutral and said it sounds like a dead battery. Sure enough that's what it was and he saved me a tow. Super honest company and if ever needed they will be the first I call

reviews.author: Debbie Carpenter
reviews.text: Thank you all for coming to the Crossnore area and picking up our truck! Very fast, professional service! And a fair price too! I highly recommend T & D Wrecker Services!!

reviews.author: Chris Wade
reviews.text: insurance accepted contacted by a operator and vehicle towed back to the address disclosed. guy driving was friendly and informative got the job done with time to spare. good job 10/10 would tow again.

reviews.author: Kathy (Kat)
reviews.text: These guys are great! My fiance's truck kinda broke on his way home and they were out there super quick and got him back home safely. I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Kinel Ozoa
reviews.text: At near midnight on a Saturday, my cars front axel decided to snap. T & D was there in less than twenty minutes, scooping up my car with practiced ease and back to my house in no time at all for a more than reasonable price! I'll be singing their grace's to anyone I can!

reviews.author: glenda warren
reviews.text: Very nice owner & employees. Price was a lot less than other tow companies. I give them a big thumbs up!

reviews.author: CathyAnn Scott
reviews.text: Picked my car up not just once, but twice when I needed it. Very professional and amazing to do business with. Pricing is very reasonable. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Chuck Rathke
reviews.text: T&D wrecker service called out by the Marion NC Police Department, to toe our motorhome. After checking into things, found out that this motorhome was not towed. That is why they replaced one front steer tire, so they could drive it. The tire they installed on the vehicle was two sizes too big. If you look at the picture it would not even clear the fender well. Well in their storage, which is supposed to be secure storage, that they charged us $30 a day. All of the manuals or stolen. I’ll together a $700 bill they were not break down the bill for their towing and ties repair & storage. According to North Carolina Department of transportation, it was illegal for them to install this tire on this vehicle being way oversized. In my opinion in my opinion only this is the type of towing company to stay away from.

reviews.author: Kyle CARTER
reviews.text: They took my car left all 4 windows down in the rainstorm. I got put my car in it, and it had 2 inches of water in a Floorboard with major electricall Damage. And then tried to blame someone else for the damages. I'm trying to take them to court in order to recover my property that was damaged

reviews.author: Effective Insurance Group EIG
reviews.text: 10 stars for these great folks! So glad they were available at 3 a.m. They went above and beyond helping my daughter with her vehicle. Very responsive, timely, friendly and helpful!!

reviews.author: Moseley Matheson
reviews.text: Quick and very reasonable. Showed up when I was told and got me taken care of fast. Tory was great to work with.

reviews.author: Tom Van
reviews.text: I called these folks, they showed up quick, they were very careful with my corvette and towed me all the way back to Asheville. Unloaded my Vette at ease. Awesome job T & D thank you

reviews.author: Randi Harper
reviews.text: Stuck on freeway. Called, and they arrived within half hour. Told us who to call to get tire. Very friendly. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: J (firekiller2)
reviews.text: I just needed a tow to my house. The guy came off rude and unprofessional. This is usually not the experience I have with yall.

reviews.author: Sean Miller
reviews.text: Absolutely phenomenal service. The operator named Mark was a good man and got to me incredibly fast. Would highly recommend

reviews.author: George C
reviews.text: Highly recommend them for towing.They answer their phone, call you back, and show up when they say they'll show up. Reasonably priced and easy to deal with.

reviews.author: pam freshour
reviews.text: They were prompt in arriving at my home to tow my vehicle. Courteous and knowledgeable. Price was very exceptable.

reviews.author: Bridget Waycaster
reviews.text: These are the nicest people ever, very helpful and very reasonable prices!! Always can call on them to help. Very respectable to women and thats always a big plus!!

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.text: Called to have a car towed ....very promt and friendly service...and at a decent and affordable price, highly recommended and would and will call again and for all my towing needs thanks again and 5 stars !

reviews.author: Robbie Hancock
reviews.text: I called these guys to tow my car all the way to Hendersonville and they did and didn't charge me a arm and leg. They are very reasonably..I will give them my business when I need it.

reviews.author: Phil
reviews.text: Don was very helpful and getting my car towed from Morgantown to Monroe North Carolina... And I highly recommend their wrecker service.

reviews.author: Dana Penley
reviews.text: They called me back and said they wasn't going to be able to help me till morning what a bunch of Bologna .

reviews.author: James Bond
reviews.text: I called, they answered. John helped me out with amazing customer service. I would recommend this place for anyone needing a tow.

reviews.author: Sam Gahagan
reviews.text: I broke down on the highway yesterday morning, called T&D. The young man arrived in 15 minutes. Totally professional, carefully loaded my camper onto the clean rollback and dropped us at the Ram dealership. I’m grateful to know such an excellent service is available locally. I hope I don’t have to call ever again but it’s definitely reassuring to know I can get help quickly.

reviews.author: Brian De La Cruz
reviews.text: Absolutely class! Called in for some assistance and he let me know of a long wait time, but that I could call him back if I didn't find anyone else. Middle of the night atop I-40W, no one is picking up. Called back and was able to come pick me up himself instead of having me wait hours more. He was quick, professional, and would highly recommend.
